parsed.note: WINDOW_PATTERN=SSSL is a freely editable training hyperparameter that leaves the fixed evaluation block (EVAL_SHARD=0, val split, fixed token count) untouched, and training still uses shards 1-10 with no overlap with the eval shard, so val_bpb remains a genuine quality metric.
